Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The Federico II University Penitentiary Center at the Secondigliano P. Mandato Penitentiary Center was founded in 2017 and opened in the first academic year (2018-2019). The over 100 students are divided into two sections: the high-security "Ionio" and the medium-security "Mediterraneo." The spaces, and therefore the time and movement options within the Pavilions, are very different, and the University, as part of the work of the National Conference of Penitentiary Facilities (PUP) at the CRUI (Italian University Rectorate), is committed to developing guidelines for national penitentiary facilities with PUPs. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 15:00
Institution: Politecnico TORINO, Torino
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-01 Idraulica, idrologia, costruzioni idrauliche e marittime

The research will develop tools to assess the physical realism and reliability of AI climate models and emulators. To this end, AQUA (Application for QUality Assessment), a Python suite developed at Politecnico di Torino to evaluate high-resolution kilometre-scale models, will be extended to meet the needs of AI climate emulators. The work is part of Horizon Europe’s CLAIMA project, which will build a European climate AI modelling platform for HPC and AI Factory infrastructures, aligned with Destination Earth. The tools will assess simulations produced by emulators and AI foundation models, test their physical consistency, identify key biases and guide improvements, particularly for climate…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Assessment of the Effectiveness of Soil Washing Treatment Applied to PFAS-Contaminated Soils - 2026_IDR_DICA_19 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-02 Ingegneria sanitaria-ambientale, ingegneria e sicurezza degli scavi, delle materie prime, degli idrocarburi e fluidi nel sottosuolo

The activity will focus on assessing the effectiveness of soil washing treatment applied to PFAS-contaminated soils through detailed chemical analyses performed before and after the treatment process, with the aim of quantifying the reduction in contaminant concentrations and estimating removal efficiencies. The activity will also include the monitoring and determination of PFAS concentrations in the sludge generated during treatment, in order to investigate contaminant transfer mechanisms, assess their potential accumulation in secondary matrices, and identify the most appropriate strategies for the management, treatment, and disposal of the resulting residues.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-06 Scienza delle costruzioni

The project is structured into two research lines. The first concerns the analysis of masonry structures and aims to develop models and algorithms for safety assessment, with particular attention to thrusting systems such as arches, vaults and arch bridges, using methods based on limit analysis. The load-bearing capacity of the structures, the effects of support settlements and collapse mechanisms will be examined. The second line focuses on the study of metamaterials through the design of units and lattices with programmable nonlinear responses, aimed at developing bistable, multistable or high-performance structures. In particular, metamaterials inspired by tensegrity and origami…

Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

Urban mobility has undergone a significant push toward the use of soft mobility or micro-mobility transport modes. This operational scenario requires the development of new methodologies for assessing urban safety, especially with regard to vulnerable users. Activities will include: 1) the development and calibration of new predictive models of pedestrian crowding in urban areas based on GIS-type architectures and employing hybrid natural configurational approaches; 2) the development ofmicro-mobility severity assessment functions; and 3) in-depth study of the design of vertical traffic calming devices

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. ROMA TRE, Roma
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The Research Group operating within the academic discipline of CEAR 03/A has constructed full-scale test sections under controlled conditions, in which the rigid pavements and concrete elements have been instrumented using FBG optical fibre sensors embedded directly into the concrete.The research activity covered by this call will therefore focus on validating the performance of the prototype system. Validation will be carried out through a statistical comparison of the experimental data with the results obtained using the main models available in the literature, including the Westergaard, Thomlison and FAA models.

Digital Twins (DTs) integrate sensor-generated data with geometric, semantic, and contextual information from Building Information Modelling (BIM), supporting the management and maintenance of buildings and infrastructure. However, their adoption in Asset and Facility Management (A&FM) is often constrained by the complexity of accessing and interpreting heterogeneous data. This research will investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) as natural-language interfaces to Digital Twins, enabling users to access and interpret data without advanced technical expertise. It will develop and validate an LLM-enabled framework to transform Digital Twin data into actionable information…

Development within a Python environment of spectral libraries, chemometric procedures for processing drone-acquired hyperspectral data, and classification and model-selection algorithms aimed at identifying asbestos-containing materials (ACM). Activities include integrated field-to-laboratory validation, asbestos fiber quantification, thematic map generation, and GIS integration, all aimed at establishing procedural and operational guidelines.
